body: SCOUT exact-SHA source review of 1f6c264: ACCEPT the production guard and fail-closed WeightedMean polarity. The shared scalar door refuses invalid weights before all reducer branches, preserves lawful zero weights, and uses the same Missing reason as the already-gated caller. One test-coverage condition: kernelAt is a separate public factory with its own newly added refuseInvalidWeights call, but every new invalid-weight assertion exercises scalar(...) only. Add one kernelAt reducer assertion for NaN/+Inf/negative weight so removing or missing that second guard makes a named court red. The present tests cannot fail if kernelAt alone regresses. No other finding; no gate verdict.
